name: optimistic-item
title: Optimistic item
description: Wraps a list item the server has not confirmed yet: dimmed and busy while pending, with Retry and Discard if it failed.
docs: Wrap a row, comment or card and pass status: confirmed adds nothing, pending dims the item and marks it busy without blocking it, failed keeps it visible with Could not save and Retry and Discard buttons. error says why. Moving from pending to confirmed is instant and silent; a failure is announced once as an alert and focus is never moved by it (after Retry it rests on the item). Keep the top right corner of the wrapped item free: the pending spinner sits there.
